title: Site 12 Electrical & Hydraulic Isolation Procedure
steps: 1. Notify Site 12 Duty Supervisor before commencing panel opening.
2. Disconnect and lock out main 415V breaker CB-204 at Substation B.
3. Apply personal Lockout Tagout (LOTO) padlock and tag.
4. Verify Zero Energy State using calibrated digital multimeter on terminals L1, L2, L3.
5. Close hydraulic suction and discharge isolation valves V-12A and V-12B.
6. Depressurize hydraulic manifold via bleed valve BV-01 into catch tray before touching sensor PT-204.
7. Wear Class 0 insulated safety gloves, safety glasses, and arc-flash face shield.

title: General Lockout Tagout Standard Operating Procedure
steps: 1. Identify all energy sources (electrical, pneumatic, mechanical).
2. Isolate each source using approved LOTO hardware.
3. Bleed residual pressure or dissipate stored kinetic/capacitive energy.
4. Attempt equipment restart to confirm lockout effectiveness.
